# Eissya Physio

Independent, one-to-one home physiotherapy within Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia, provided by Nur Siti Eissya.

## Main pages
- https://eissya.site/home-physiotherapy-ipoh/ — home visit service and suitability
- https://eissya.site/stroke-rehabilitation-ipoh/ — movement and mobility support after stroke
- https://eissya.site/elderly-physiotherapy-ipoh/ — mobility and balance support for older adults
- https://eissya.site/pricing/ — session and package prices
- https://eissya.site/about/ — physiotherapist background
- https://eissya.site/contact/ — WhatsApp enquiry

Home visits are available in Ipoh only. A single session is RM140; three sessions are RM400; eight sessions are RM1,000. Transport fees depend on distance within Ipoh and are confirmed before booking. Content does not replace individual medical assessment.
